Before (round open, no census): UNMET passed=0 cases=150. Target: MET passed=150 cases=150 at the measured commit.
A CONTROL is a program that skips the claimed work: it does not read the mirror, or reads it but encodes no per-member rule (name or chain template + kind + permission ceiling, sidecars and chain generations optional), or decides on anything other than the mirror's shape. Every control must read UNMET; if any control reads MET the claim is redesigned before data. In this wave NO seat runs the counter on a real census candidate; controls only.
